name: UNHCR DAFI Scholarship - Protestant University of Rwanda
provider: UNHCR / DAFI and Protestant University of Rwanda
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Recognised refugees or asylum seekers living in Rwanda with a PUR admission letter; not holding another higher-education scholarship. University covers tuition; UNHCR covers a monthly allowance for accommodation, transport and food. 30 places for 2026-2027. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Zawadi Africa Education Fund Scholarship (Kenya)
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Academically gifted young women from financially disadvantaged backgrounds, applying through the Kenya office; a 9-month programme then placement at partner universities. The 2027 call is not yet published; this is the 2026 deadline. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: UCT Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (2027 intake)
provider: Mastercard Foundation / University of Cape Town
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Academically talented, economically disadvantaged African students. Undergraduate deadline was 30/09/2026; postgraduate (honours/Master's) deadline was 31/10/2026. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Pretoria Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (2027 intake)
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Disadvantaged African youth with leadership potential. Undergraduate deadline 31/08/2026; postgraduate (honours/Master's) deadline 30/09/2026. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Makerere Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (2026/2027)
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. 245 undergraduate and 13 Master's scholarships for 2026/2027 at Makerere main campus; apply for admission first. The Master's call is part of the same announcement. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: ALU Scholarship - Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
eligibility: FULL - OPEN. Need-based full scholarship; apply for admission to ALU Rwanda (January 2027 intake) and eligible applicants are considered. Priority to young women, refugees and people with disabilities. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship (Fall 2027)
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Tuition, books, incidental fees and residence for four years. Students must be nominated by their secondary school; this date is the school nomination deadline, so no new candidates can enter. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Berea College International Admission (fully funded)
eligibility: FULL - OPEN. All admitted international students receive aid covering 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees; Work Program participation. Admitted international students pay a USD 2,200 deposit before the I-20. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: EARTH University Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
eligibility: FULL - tuition and basic living expenses for EARTH's four-year Agricultural Sciences degree in Costa Rica, plus mentoring and career support. For young people from disadvantaged communities in Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean who meet EARTH admission criteria and face financial barriers. Apply to EARTH first.

name: ALCHE Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (Mauritian applicants)
provider: African Leadership College of Higher Education and Mastercard Foundation
eligibility: FULL - full-ride scholarship for Mauritian citizens applying to ALCHE for the February 2027 intake. Requires financial need, strong national exam results (B average) and leadership potential; apply for ALCHE admission first. The international-applicant deadline (14/11/2026) has passed.

name: Reach Oxford Scholarship (2027 entry)
eligibility: FULL - course fees, living-cost grant and one return airfare per year (about 2-3 awards a year). ONLY for nationals of listed low-income countries (South Sudan is listed; not every African country is). You must already hold an Oxford offer - Oxford's 2027 course applications closed on 15/10/2026. Excludes Medicine. Application details are published in January 2027.

name: Wesleyan African Scholars Program
eligibility: FULL - full cost of attendance for four years for about 10 students a year. Citizens or permanent residents of any African country (not US dual citizens/permanent residents) who apply for need-based aid and have not enrolled full-time at a university before. No separate form. Apply for admission by 01/01/2027; this date is the international financial-aid deadline. Aid for international applicants is limited and highly selective.

name: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Harvard meets 100% of demonstrated need for all four years, same aid regardless of citizenship. not a scholarship you apply for separately and not guaranteed: only admitted students receive aid, based on family finances. Available regardless of citizenship. Apply for admission by 01/01/2027 (Regular Decision); this date is the aid deadline (CSS Profile and IDOC).

name: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Yale meets 100% of demonstrated need with scholarships, not loans, regardless of citizenship. only for admitted students and based on family finances; not guaranteed. Indicate aid on the admission application. Apply for admission by 02/01/2027 (Regular Decision); this date is Yale's Regular Decision PRIORITY aid deadline.

name: Princeton Undergraduate Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - grant aid (no loans) meeting 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students regardless of citizenship; not guaranteed before admission. Uses the Princeton Financial Aid Application, not the CSS Profile. Apply for admission by the early-January Regular Decision deadline; this date is the aid deadline.

name: MIT Undergraduate Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - MIT meets demonstrated need for admitted international students; not guaranteed before admission. Requires CSS Profile and parental income documents via IDOC. Apply for admission by the early-January Regular Action deadline; this date is the aid deadline.

name: Brown University Financial Aid (international first-year)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Brown is need-blind for first-year international applicants and meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students; not guaranteed before admission. CSS Profile required. This date is the Regular Decision aid deadline; apply for admission by Brown's earlier January deadline.

name: Bowdoin College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Bowdoin is need-blind for international applicants and meets full calculated need of admitted students; not guaranteed before admission. International applicants submit aid forms only after being admitted, so this date is the Regular Decision ADMISSION deadline you must meet.

name: University of Notre Dame Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - need-blind admission for international applicants; meets 100% of demonstrated need of admitted students; not guaranteed before admission. CSS Profile required. Apply for admission by 04/01/2027; this date is the Regular Decision PRIORITY aid date.

name: Tufts University Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Tufts meets 100% of demonstrated need of every admitted student regardless of citizenship. only if requested on the admission application; it cannot be requested later. Admitted international students then submit the CSS Profile within 5-7 days of their decision. Not guaranteed. This date is the Regular Decision ADMISSION deadline, when aid must be requested.

name: Dartmouth College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - need-blind admission for international citizens; Dartmouth meets the demonstrated need of all admitted undergraduates; not guaranteed before admission. Apply for admission by the early-January Regular Decision deadline; this date is the aid deadline.

name: Turkiye Burslari (Turkiye Scholarships) Bachelor's
eligibility: FULL - tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, one-year Turkish course and a one-off flight ticket. Open to international students; minimum 70% academic average for bachelor's applicants. UPCOMING: the official annual window is 10 January - 20 February; apply online at tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr. Confirm the 2027 announcement when it is published.

name: UGHE MBBS-MGHD Scholarship (University of Global Health Equity)
eligibility: FULL - tuition, dormitory housing, food, local health insurance and academic costs for the medicine dual degree in Rwanda, IN EXCHANGE FOR years of service with the Ministry of Health (repayment if you leave early). No stipend; you pay travel and visa. ONLY citizens of Burundi, DRC, Rwanda, Tanzania, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Malawi, Lesotho, Eritrea, South Sudan and Sudan, or refugees in Africa. Needs Biology and Chemistry.

name: Amherst College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Amherst is need-blind for all applicants, including international, and meets full demonstrated need of admitted students; not guaranteed before admission. CSS Profile required. Apply for admission by 05/01/2027; this date is the Regular Decision aid deadline.

name: Williams College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - all-grant aid (no loans) meeting 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students; not guaranteed before admission. International students who do not apply for aid during admission cannot receive it later. Admission and aid applications are both due on this date (Regular Decision).

name: Wellesley College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Wellesley meets 100% of calculated need for admitted international citizens who applied for aid during admission; aid is limited and admission is competitive for aid applicants. Women's college. Admission and aid are both due on this date (Regular Decision).

name: Swarthmore College Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - if admitted and you applied for aid, Swarthmore meets 100% of determined need regardless of citizenship, with no loans; not guaranteed before admission. International aid documents are due within 7 days of the admission decision, so this date is the Regular Decision ADMISSION deadline.

name: Stanford University Financial Aid (international)
eligibility: FULL NEED MET (need-based) - Stanford meets the full need of all admitted students regardless of citizenship (international aid applicants face more selective admission). only if you state on the admission application that you are applying for aid; it cannot be requested later. Not guaranteed before admission. CSS Profile required. Apply for admission by the early-January Regular Decision deadline; this date is the international PRIORITY aid filing date.

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships (2027/28)
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
eligibility: FULL - OPEN. One-year taught Master's at selected UK universities: full tuition fees, monthly stipend (GBP 1,712, or GBP 2,000 in London) and return airfare. Citizens of and permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country (African: Botswana, Eswatini, Gabon, Ghana, Kenya, Lesotho, Malawi, Mauritius, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, South Africa, Tanzania, The Gambia, Togo, Uganda, Zambia). Needs a 2:1 degree and must not afford UK study otherwise. Closes 16:00 GMT. Checked 20/11/2026.

name: Chevening Scholarships (2027-2028)
eligibility: FULL - CLOSED. Fully funded one-year Master's degree in the UK for citizens of Chevening-eligible countries (most African countries); undergraduate studies finished at least two years before the deadline; must return home for two years after. The 2027-2028 round closed 06/10/2026; the next round normally opens in August. Checked 20/11/2026.
